name: MARCUS BLAZE
line: Panhandling? Grand larceny? We talking about rap battles or a crime spree out here?

name: TASHA RAW
line: Call it what you want, but Calicoe just told HipHopIsReal Brizz is making easy money not battling. That's the invoice.

name: MARCUS BLAZE
line: Easy money? That's the bill for disrespecting the whole damn culture!

name: TASHA RAW
line: Respect ain't the bill, Marcus, it's the currency you pay to duck the fight.

name: MARCUS BLAZE
line: Currency? You talkin' 'bout currency when careers are on the line? That's a damn shame.

name: TASHA RAW
line: Careers? He said Brizz is traumatized and done. That's the opposite of a career move.
delivery: quiet, factual, cutting through the noise

name: MARCUS BLAZE
line: Traumatized? Done? That ain't no career move, that's a damn indictment!

name: TASHA RAW
line: Cap.

name: TASHA RAW
line: Then tell me why he's questioning Brizz's machete credibility on the same site that ran his 'too much' story.

name: MARCUS BLAZE
line: Come ON.

name: MARCUS BLAZE
line: Okay okay.

name: MARCUS BLAZE
line: Accountability is toast if we're letting 'traumatized' be an excuse to dodge.

name: TASHA RAW
line: You said dodge, but Calicoe's invoice said Brizz was circling them like a shark. So which behavior needed the excuse?

name: MARCUS BLAZE
line: Circled him? Nah, that's just Calicoe talking. My man, that's straight up evasion.

name: MARCUS BLAZE
line: This ain't about who circled who. This is about the whole damn game folding like a cheap suit. Accountability? Gone. Respect? Out the window. What are we even doing here?

name: TASHA RAW
line: Respect is the brochure, Marcus. He says he represents love and respect, then calls someone the friendliest soft ass on the circuit.

name: MARCUS BLAZE
line: He calls himself a man of respect and then trashes someone? That ain't respect, that's a lie.

name: TASHA RAW
line: So he represents love and respect, and you can't trust what he does with it either.

name: MARCUS BLAZE
line: Traumatized? Okay, I'll give you that. But then *why* is Calicoe still saying Brizz is scared of Moo? That ain't trauma, that's cowardice!

name: TASHA RAW
line: So the trauma's real but the invoice changes depending on who he's selling it to.
delivery: low, flat, with a slight head tilt

name: MARCUS BLAZE
line: So the trauma is the reason *now*, but the fear was the reason *before*? Come on, man!

name: TASHA RAW
line: Pick a receipt, Marcus. The Summer Impact trauma, or the easy money claim. They can't both be the bill.

name: MARCUS BLAZE
line: You see the receipts? Nu Jerzey Twork is accused of stealing and panhandling! That's not about trauma, that's straight up filth.

name: TASHA RAW
line: Panhandling is the invoice for respect you didn't earn. Same as ducking a fight.
delivery: low, flat, with a slight head tilt

name: MARCUS BLAZE
line: Respect? You talking about respect when he ain't even payin' for his own damn drinks?! That's not respect, that's fraud!

name: TASHA RAW
line: Respect is the thing they all claim to sell when the bill comes due.
